decision.summary: A multi-axis step-like event begins near index 439: N and U rise sharply (~+10 MAD) and remain elevated through 444; E drops ~−5 MAD starting ~440 and stays low. The onset is multi-sample and coherent across N/U, but the return is unobserved within allowed context (ends at 480, last sample at 479 is still elevated in N/U and depressed in E). No opposing return detected; thus interval is classified as uncertain. A large outlier at index 440 (12.8, −6.0, 12.8) appears to be part of this transient offset, not a separate permanent step—its magnitude aligns with the jump vector at 439 and persists for several samples before gradual decay. No evidence of recovery before end of window.

intervals.observation: N and U show a sharp multi-sample upward shift starting near index 439 (coincident with candidate jump at 439), sustained through 444; E shows a delayed downward offset beginning ~440, persisting through 444. No return observed within allowed context [400,480]; interior is elevated/sustained on N/U, depressed on E. Return not confirmed; status uncertain.
